observation_kind: targeted current official title-descriptor, pagination, OGC Features and TIN/vector-tile checks; not independent bulk HTTP fetches
rules: Title_No is a mandatory character identifier in the Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset.
UPRN is a mandatory integer identifier of a spatial address.
Post-office addresses excluded from AddressBase have no UPRN and are absent from the lookup dataset.
Where one title affects many properties, all affecting UPRNs may be associated.
HMLR imports and matches an AddressBase change-only update every six weeks.
Published lookup data shows only the last change made during the six-week maintenance period.
The UPRN lookup delivery provides a full file and validation file, without a change-only file.
The full lookup file follows the LR_UPRN_FULL_<month> CSV naming pattern.
The validation file follows the LR_UPRN_VALI_<month> CSV naming pattern.
A title number can have only one class of title.
A pending registration can have a title number without estate-interest or class-of-title values.
Registered status is Pending while an application is processed and blank when the title is registered.
Title Descriptor change indicators are New, Changed or Deleted.
Title Descriptor data may change more than once per month, but only the latest state is published.
Exact current Barnet and Enfield INSPIRE GML hrefs, bytes and hashes remain unavailable.
Current INSPIRE IDs and native-BNG containment remain unresolved for the three candidates.
Entity search supports json, html and geojson extensions.
Entity responses include next, prev, first and last pagination links.
Large result sets are paged by increasing offset by the chosen limit.
The API does not provide a batch endpoint for portfolio queries.
The official guide directs per-property clients to apply polite rate limiting.
The dataset-list endpoint supports json and html extensions.
Setting include_typologies to false removes typologies from dataset JSON responses.
The single-dataset endpoint supports json and html extensions.
Custom WKT geometry coordinates must use WGS84, EPSG:4326.
Exact current title-boundary responses for references 52040420, 52213916 and 52213412 remain unavailable.
Exact current point-intersection responses for all three candidate coordinates remain unavailable.
Authoritative UPRN bindings for the three candidates remain unavailable.
The official OGC Features landing page links an OpenAPI definition.
The landing page links the service collection list.
The landing page links a conformance declaration.
The 1m DTM extent collection uses EPSG:27700 as its storage CRS.
The collection exposes geometry as a queryable property.
The collection exposes filename as a queryable property.
The collection exposes tilename as a queryable property.
The collection exposes start and end flown timestamps for survey lineage.
An exact TQ2892 collection feature and survey dates remain unavailable through the current safe transport.
Exact candidate DTM pixel values are not supplied by the metadata collection and remain unavailable.
The source DTM is captured as a triangulated irregular network.
The source TIN is edited with mass points, breaklines and automated techniques in a photogrammetric environment.
The official specification states that a TIN retains feature edges more accurately than a grid.
Both grid and contour products are interpolated from the source TIN model.
Terrain 50 contours are supplied as one national MBTiles vector-tile set.
The vector-tile supply uses Web Mercator, EPSG:3857.
Terrain 50 vector-tile layer attributes are mapped at zoom levels 9 through 14 and not at 0 through 8.
The exact current Terrain 50 area=TQ download response remains unavailable.
Current TQ29 archive bytes, inventory and cryptographic hashes remain unavailable.
Actual Terrain 50 target-cell values for all three candidates remain unavailable.
